content.comment_body: I've recently encountered the same problem. Everything was functioning normally and I could connect to the [product_name] as usual. Once I enabled HTTPS, all connectivity stopped working. I was unable to connect to the [product_name], so I disconnected devices, performed a factory reset, and reloaded the configuration. Still, I kept running into download errors, which I traced back to the [product_name] communication module being connected. Both devices are brand new and running the latest firmware.

analysis.insight_summary: The user ran into connectivity and download issues after activating HTTPS on [company_name] modules. Investigation revealed a conflict when both the base module and communication module were connected at the same time. Both modules used updated firmware and were recently purchased, indicating the issue likely results from incompatibility between recent hardware or firmware and security configuration rather than user mistakes or outdated devices.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects smooth program downloads and stable connectivity, even with security features like HTTPS activated, and without hardware modules interfering with each other.
